digest.component_or_area: AGENTS.md documentation and CI structural gates
propositions: AGENTS.md documents the 800-LOC module-size gate but omits the shrink-only C901 cyclomatic-complexity ratchet (.github/complexity-baseline.json, threshold 15), causing implementers to discover it only at pre-flight when routine changes (flag/guard additions) exceed per-symbol ceilings

The C901 complexity ratchet is a structural CI gate enforced by make lint (via scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check) that fails on new or increased function complexity but is invisible to behavioral tests and linters

Adding documentation to AGENTS.md alongside the Module-size policy section will surface the complexity ratchet, explain the shrink-only semantics, name the baseline file and threshold source, and direct implementers to behavior-preserving extraction as the only remedy
